newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish gunmen kill barman over Allah tattoo.
newsitem.headline: Turkish gunmen kill barman over Allah tattoo.

text.p: Two Turkish gunmen shot dead a well-known barman they felt was insulting Islam by wearing a tattoo of the word "Allah" in Arabic on his shoulder, Turkish newspapers said on Tuesday.
The Hurriyet daily said the attackers cut down Oguz Atak as he walked his dog in the exclusive Istanbul district of Bebek in a drive-by shooting on Monday.
Police arrested the gunmen who said they had seen Atak on a television programme and been angered by someone who worked in a bar flaunting the name of Allah.
Consuming alcohol is forbidden under Islam but drink is widely available in officially secular Turkey.

The country has been hotly debating the role of religion since Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan became modern Turkey's first Islamist leader last year. The secularist army said last week halting rising Islamist activity was a matter of "life or death".
